# The Flavor Factory: Company Summary

The Flavor Factory is a family-owned custom flavor manufacturer based at 2058 Second Street in Norco, California. The company develops and manufactures custom liquid and powder flavor systems for brands, product developers, manufacturers, and co-packers. Projects are developed around the finished product: its base, processing conditions, format, label goals, benchmark, and scale-up requirements.

## What The Flavor Factory Does

The Flavor Factory provides custom liquid flavors, custom powder flavors, flavor matching, reformulation, masking, modulation, sweetness balance, cooling balance, heat-stable flavor development, natural flavor development, and organic-compliant flavor capabilities. Work moves from brief to sample development to revision to repeatable production from one Norco facility.

## Applications

The company supports beverage, bakery, confectionery, dairy and frozen, nutraceutical, oral care, pharmaceutical, popcorn, seasoning, syrup, and related finished-product applications.

## Why Customers Work With The Flavor Factory

The Flavor Factory is a hands-on family business. Development, customer communication, production, quality, and regulatory support are connected under one roof. The team focuses on flavors that perform inside the real product rather than generic catalog samples.
